Tailors the plan to your goals
useCases: Students wanting a structured plan to learn a new skill
Self-learners who want a personalized path at their own pace
howTo: Go to the WisdomPlan website and sign up
Tell it the skill you want to learn
Let it build a personalized learning plan
Follow the plan and progress at your own pace

example.label: Example goal
example.code: Build me a learning plan to master Python over the next 3 months.

goodToKnow: The plan is a guide; your progress still depends on your own practice.

tool/writerzen.tagline: Find keywords and plan articles around them
tool/writerzen.overview: WriterZen is a keyword research and content tool that finds search terms and helps you plan and write articles around them. It combines discovering keywords with planning the content you build on top of them.
useCases: An SEO writer researching what terms to target
A content team planning articles around the right keywords
howTo: Open the WriterZen website and sign in
Research keywords for your topic
Use the findings to plan an article outline
Write the content around your chosen keywords

example.label: Workflow
example.code:
1. Search keyword: "home workout"
2. Review related terms + volume
3. Plan article around top terms

goodToKnow: Keyword data guides planning but should be paired with your own judgment.
Check the site for pricing and plan limits.

tool/writier.tagline: Sentence suggestions to beat writer's block
tool/writier.overview: Writier suggests sentence completions as you write to help you push through writer's block. It offers continuations so you can keep your writing flowing.
useCases: A writer who keeps getting stuck mid-sentence
A student who wants nudges to keep their draft moving
howTo: Open the Writier website
Start writing in the editor
Accept or ignore the sentence suggestions it offers
Continue writing and edit as you go

example.label: In-editor
example.code:
You type: "The main reason I started this project was"
Writier suggests: "...to solve a problem I kept running into myself."

goodToKnow: Suggestions are aids, so edit them to keep your own voice.
Check the site for any account or usage limits.

tool/wui-ai.tagline: Cut long videos into short-form clips
tool/wui-ai.overview: WUI.AI edits long videos down into short-form clips for platforms like TikTok and Reels, picking moments and cutting them automatically. It is built to repurpose long content into shareable shorts without manual editing.
capabilities: Edit long videos into short clips
Create clips for TikTok and Reels
useCases: A creator turning long videos into short-form clips
A marketer repurposing a long video into social shorts
howTo: Open the WUI.AI website and upload or link your long video
Let it analyze the video and pick clip-worthy moments
Review the suggested short clips
Export the clips for TikTok, Reels, or other platforms

example.label: Workflow
example.code: Upload 30-min video → AI picks highlights → export vertical short clips

goodToKnow: Automatically picked moments may need review to make sure the best parts are chosen.
Check the site for supported formats and usage limits.

tool/x-pilot-ai.tagline: Turn text into concept-visualizing course videos
tool/x-pilot-ai.overview: X-Pilot AI turns written text into course videos that visualize the concepts being explained. It is built to make educational content easier to follow by showing the ideas, not just telling them.
useCases: An educator turning written lessons into explainer videos
A creator who wants concepts visualized for learners
howTo: Open the X-Pilot AI website
Enter or paste the text you want turned into a course video
Generate the video that visualizes the concepts
Review and export the result

example.label: Input
example.code: Paste lesson text → generate course video that visualizes the concepts

goodToKnow: Review the generated visuals to make sure they accurately represent the concepts.
Check the site for export formats and usage limits.

tool/yolly-ai.tagline: Generate videos and images from text
tool/yolly-ai.overview: Yolly AI generates both videos and images from text in one creative tool. You describe what you want in words and it produces visual content, covering two media types in a single place.
useCases: Creators who need both images and videos from one place
Anyone turning text prompts into visual content quickly
howTo: Go to https://www.yolly.ai and sign up
Choose whether to generate a video or an image
Enter a text prompt describing what you want
Generate and download your result

example.label: Try it
example.code: Open https://www.yolly.ai and type a prompt like 'a calm sunset over mountains' to generate an image or video.

goodToKnow: It handles both image and video generation from text.
Detailed prompts usually produce better results.

tool/z-image.tagline: Generate images from text, built to run efficiently
tool/z-image.overview: Z-Image generates images from text prompts. It is built to run efficiently, so you describe what you want and it produces an image.
useCases: Someone who wants to create images by describing them in words
A creator needing quick visuals without drawing them by hand
howTo: Open Z-Image
Write a text prompt describing the image you want
Generate the image
Refine your prompt and generate again if needed

example.label: Prompt example
example.code: A calm mountain lake at sunrise, soft light, photorealistic

goodToKnow: No website link was provided, so look up where to access it.
Image quality depends on how clearly you describe your prompt.
